settings.text: Every piece is hand-selected in the Paris outlets, authenticated, and shipped to your doorstep — no markup games, no compromise on quality. Just the best of French luxury at prices that finally make sense.
settings.points: Hand-selected & authenticated|Real outlet prices|Tracked worldwide delivery

settings.title: Send your wishlist
settings.text: Paste the links of the items you want — sizes, colors, budget. Straight from your phone: no visa, no flights, no hotel.

settings.title: I scout, you validate
settings.text: I go to La Vallée Village & Val d'Europe, send you real-time photos and outlet prices. Nothing is bought without your go.

settings.title: We settle & ship
settings.text: Final payment, careful packing and tracked Colissimo delivery to your door — Europe, Turkey & beyond.

settings.title: Handpicked, at outlet price
settings.subtitle: A glimpse of what I find in the Paris outlets. Ask for any of these — or anything similar.

settings.title: 20% commission, nothing hidden
settings.subtitle: 20% commission on your purchases (minimum 300 €), and no minimum spend. That commission covers the outlet trips, the scouting, the photos, the packing and the shipping — slide below to see what it looks like for your budget.

settings.question: How does payment work?
settings.answer: After we validate your list together, you pay a deposit covering the estimated purchases + my provisional commission (Wise, PayPal or bank transfer).

settings.question: How do I know it's authentic?
settings.answer: All products are bought in the official boutiques of the Paris outlets. Original invoice, receipt and photos are sent with every purchase.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: Across Europe and worldwide, with a tracked parcel to the address on your account.
